name: Palm sugar
summary: Đường thốt nốt is palm sugar from the palms around Châu Đốc. VnExpress lists it as a gift, with the fruit. The An Giang portal says people in the Bảy Núi have long made palm juice, palm sugar, and bánh bò thốt nốt from the same tree. A Châu Đốc price was not printed.
origin: The plains around Châu Đốc, on Vietnam Tourism’s charms chapter, and the Bảy Núi on the An Giang portal, 21 Aug 2024.
howToEat: Carry a cake of it home. VnExpress on 26 Apr 2024 lists đường thốt nốt and quả thốt nốt together. The jelly of the fruit is the chè, a separate bowl.
The An Giang portal also names nước thốt nốt, rượu thốt nốt, and thốt nốt rim as An Giang products, and does not place those three in Châu Đốc.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Châu Đốc, as a gift on the VnExpress handbook. A shop was not named. The palms stand on the roads between the center and the sights.
seoTitle: Duong thot not in Chau Doc
seoDescription: Đường thốt nốt is the palm sugar VnExpress says to carry home from Châu Đốc. The An Giang portal ties it to the Bảy Núi. A price was not printed.
